Definition: testAn early spelling of hippocras, used by Chaucer. It was a cordial drink made of wine flavoured with spices.
Discussion: testIt occurs in a petition by the spicers in York: 1433 whare as we haf had wythouten tyme of mynde the sherch of swet wynes alswhele grewand as confect, ypocras, clarre and all other (YRS106/176)
